statement: The Great Wall of China is visible from space with the naked eye.
explanation: Too narrow. Even Chinese astronaut Yang Liwei confirmed he couldn't see it.

statement: A human could survive on Mars without a spacesuit for about 2 minutes.
explanation: You'd lose consciousness in ~15 seconds due to lack of oxygen. Death follows in minutes from hypoxia and rapid decompression.

statement: Sharks are the ocean's top predators and have no natural enemies.
explanation: Orcas (killer whales) regularly hunt and kill great white sharks, flipping them onto their backs to cause tonic immobility.

statement: The human body generates enough heat in 30 minutes to boil half a litre of water.
explanation: The human body produces about 100 watts of heat at rest — enough to boil 0.5L of water in around 30 minutes.

statement: Diamonds are the hardest natural substance on Earth.
explanation: Diamonds score 10 on the Mohs hardness scale — the maximum. Only synthetic materials like wurtzite boron nitride are harder.

statement: You lose most of your body heat through your head.
explanation: The head accounts for only about 10% of heat loss — proportional to its surface area. The myth came from a flawed 1950s military study.

statement: Goldfish have a 3-second memory.
explanation: Studies show goldfish remember learned behaviours for months. They can be trained to press levers and navigate mazes.

statement: The tongue is the strongest muscle in the human body.
explanation: The masseter (jaw) is strongest relative to size; the glutes and quads produce more raw force. The tongue myth has no scientific basis.
hook: Is your tongue your strongest muscle?

statement: Water drains clockwise in the southern hemisphere and anticlockwise in the north.
explanation: The Coriolis effect is real but too weak to affect a bathtub. Drain direction is determined by the bowl's shape and residual motion.

statement: Lightning never strikes the same place twice.
explanation: The Empire State Building is struck ~23 times per year. Tall structures are natural lightning rods and attract repeated strikes.

statement: Humans are the only animals that cry from emotion.
explanation: Elephants, chimpanzees and dogs produce tears in emotional states. Whether it's 'crying' emotionally is still debated by scientists.

statement: If you shave hair, it grows back thicker and darker.
explanation: Shaving cuts hair at its widest point, making regrowth feel stubbly and appear darker — but it doesn't change growth rate or colour.

statement: Eating carrots improves your night vision.
explanation: British WWII propaganda invented this to hide radar technology. Carrots help if you're deficient in vitamin A — otherwise they do nothing.

statement: The sun is yellow.
explanation: The Sun emits white light. It appears yellow or orange from Earth's surface due to atmospheric scattering. From space it is white.

statement: Bats are blind.
explanation: All bat species can see. Most use echolocation to navigate in the dark, but their eyes function — some bats have excellent vision.

statement: The human body replaces all its cells every 7 years.
explanation: Different cells have different lifespans. Neurons can last a lifetime; gut cells last 5 days. There's no uniform 7-year cycle.
hook: Do you replace yourself every 7 years?

statement: Mount Everest is the tallest mountain on Earth.
explanation: Everest is highest above sea level (8,848m). Mauna Kea (Hawaii) is tallest from base to peak (10,210m). Chimborazo (Ecuador) is furthest from Earth's centre.

statement: Napoleon was extremely short for his time.
explanation: Napoleon stood 5'7" — average for a Frenchman in the 1800s. The 'short Napoleon' myth came from British propaganda and a unit conversion error.

statement: Humans have only 5 senses.
explanation: We have at least 9: sight, hearing, taste, smell, touch, proprioception, thermoception, nociception, and equilibrioception. Aristotle only counted 5.
hook: How many senses do humans have?

statement: Chewing gum stays in your stomach for 7 years if swallowed.
explanation: Gum base is indigestible but still passes through the digestive system in days, like other insoluble fibre.

statement: Bulls are enraged by the colour red.
explanation: Cattle are red-green colour-blind. It's the movement of the matador's cape that provokes bulls — not the colour.

statement: We only use 10% of our brain.
explanation: Brain imaging shows all regions are active. Even during sleep, most of the brain has some activity. The 10% myth is completely fabricated.

statement: Hot water freezes faster than cold water.
explanation: This is the Mpemba Effect, documented since Aristotle. Under specific conditions, hot water can freeze faster than cold. The mechanism is still debated.

statement: The Great Wall of China is a single continuous wall.
explanation: The 'Wall' is a series of walls, trenches, and natural barriers built across different dynasties. Large gaps exist, especially in the west.

statement: Humans and dinosaurs coexisted on Earth.
explanation: Non-avian dinosaurs went extinct ~66 million years ago. Modern humans appeared ~300,000 years ago. There's a 65.7 million-year gap.

statement: Antibiotics are effective against viral infections like the flu.
explanation: Antibiotics kill bacteria. Viruses like influenza are unaffected by them. Overuse of antibiotics contributes to antibiotic resistance.

statement: The Amazon River discharges more water than any other river on Earth.
explanation: The Amazon discharges about 20% of all freshwater entering the world's oceans — more than the next 7 largest rivers combined.

statement: You can see stars during the day from the bottom of a deep well.
explanation: This ancient belief has been tested and disproved. Daylight scattering in the atmosphere is too bright, even in a narrow column.

statement: The Moon has its own light.
explanation: The Moon produces no light. It reflects sunlight. The Sun generates light; the Moon is just a very large mirror.

statement: A penny dropped from the Empire State Building could kill someone.
explanation: A penny is too light and aerodynamic. It reaches terminal velocity of ~30km/h — enough to sting but not penetrate skin, let alone kill.

statement: The Amazon Rainforest produces 20% of the world's oxygen.
explanation: The Amazon produces AND consumes oxygen in roughly equal measure. It's essentially carbon-neutral. The '20% of oxygen' figure is a widespread misstatement.

statement: Humans swallow an average of 8 spiders a year in their sleep.
explanation: This is completely fabricated. Spiders avoid vibrations and CO₂ — sleeping humans are exactly what they avoid.

statement: Glass is technically a liquid that flows very slowly over centuries.
explanation: Medieval glass is thicker at the bottom because it was made unevenly, not because it flowed. Modern science classifies glass as an amorphous solid.

statement: The human eye can see a candle flame from 48km (30 miles) away in darkness.
explanation: On a dark, clear night with no obstructions, the human eye can theoretically detect a single candle flame at ~48km.
hook: How far can you really see?

statement: Sugar makes children hyperactive.
explanation: Multiple double-blind studies have found no link between sugar and hyperactivity in children. It's parental expectation, not physiology.

statement: Einstein failed his university entrance exam.
explanation: Einstein failed the non-science sections (French, botany) of the ETH entrance exam in 1895, but excelled in maths and physics. He retook it and passed.

statement: The Eiffel Tower grows taller in summer.
explanation: The iron structure expands in heat — the Eiffel Tower can be up to 15cm taller in summer than in winter due to thermal expansion.

statement: Humans are the only animals that have sex for pleasure.
explanation: Bonobos, dolphins, and several other animals have been observed engaging in sexual behaviour beyond reproduction — including for social bonding.

statement: Chameleons change colour to match their background.
explanation: Chameleons primarily change colour to communicate — expressing mood, temperature regulation, and mating signals. Camouflage is secondary.

statement: There is no gravity in space.
explanation: Gravity exists everywhere in space. Astronauts feel weightless because they're in free fall around Earth — not because gravity is absent.

statement: Alcohol warms you up.
explanation: Alcohol causes blood vessels to dilate, making you feel warmer while actually accelerating heat loss. It lowers core body temperature.

statement: Humans are descended from chimpanzees.
explanation: Humans and chimpanzees share a common ancestor that went extinct ~6-8 million years ago. We evolved in parallel, not from each other.

statement: You should wake a sleepwalker immediately for their safety.
explanation: Waking a sleepwalker is not dangerous to you — but it can cause confusion or distress for them. It's better to gently guide them back to bed.

statement: Oxygen is the most abundant gas in Earth's atmosphere.
explanation: Nitrogen makes up 78% of Earth's atmosphere. Oxygen is second at 21%. Argon (0.93%) comes third.

statement: Humans are the slowest runners in the animal kingdom.
explanation: Humans are among the best long-distance runners on Earth. We can outrun horses over marathon distances. Short-term we're slow; endurance-wise, we're exceptional.

statement: Tomatoes are vegetables.
explanation: Botanically, tomatoes are fruits (they contain seeds and develop from a flower). Legally and culinarily, they're vegetables. The US Supreme Court agreed in 1893.

statement: You should drink 8 glasses of water a day.
explanation: The 8-glass rule has no scientific basis. Hydration needs vary by body size, activity, and climate. Most people don't need exactly 8 glasses.

statement: The sun rises in the east and sets in the west every day.
explanation: The Sun rises exactly due east and sets due west only twice a year (the equinoxes). Otherwise it varies significantly by season and latitude.
hook: Does the sun rise in the east?

statement: Elephants are afraid of mice.
explanation: This ancient myth was debunked by experiments. Elephants don't single out mice. They can be startled by any small unfamiliar moving object.

statement: The North Star is the brightest star in the night sky.
explanation: Polaris (the North Star) is only the 48th brightest star. Sirius is the brightest star visible from Earth. Jupiter and Venus outshine them both.

statement: Napoleon was exiled to Elba for the rest of his life.
explanation: Napoleon escaped Elba after just 300 days, returned to power for the Hundred Days, and was only permanently exiled to Saint Helena after Waterloo.

statement: Cats always land on their feet.
explanation: Cats have a 'righting reflex' and usually land on their feet from moderate heights. Falls from very low or very high heights can still injure them.

statement: Swimming after eating causes cramps and drowning.
explanation: While intense exercise after a large meal may cause mild discomfort, there is no evidence that swimming after eating causes cramps or drowning.

statement: The human body has 206 bones.
explanation: Adult humans have exactly 206 bones. Babies are born with 270–300 bones; many fuse as we grow.

statement: Sushi means 'raw fish'.
explanation: Sushi means 'sour rice' (vinegared rice). The term refers to the rice, not the topping. Sashimi is specifically sliced raw fish.
hook: Do you know what sushi means?

statement: A group of crows is called a murder.
explanation: The collective noun for crows is indeed a 'murder'. Other notable examples: a parliament of owls, an unkindness of ravens.
hook: What's a group of crows called?

statement: The Sahara Desert is the world's largest desert.
explanation: Antarctica is the world's largest desert. A desert is defined by low precipitation, not heat. Antarctica receives less rainfall than the Sahara.

statement: Rome was built in a day.
explanation: The Roman Empire took roughly 244 years to reach its greatest extent under Trajan in 117 CE. The saying is proverbial, not historical.
hook: Was Rome built in a day?

statement: All continents were once joined as one landmass.
explanation: The supercontinent Pangaea existed ~335–175 million years ago. Continental drift slowly separated it into the continents we know today.

statement: The word 'set' has the most definitions in the English language.
explanation: 'Set' has over 430 definitions in the Oxford English Dictionary — the most of any English word.
hook: What word has the most meanings?
